snippet.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 - Official Season 3 Story Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description: Uncover the truth about Pantheon buried deep within the past when Season 3 of Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 launches on April 2, 2025. Check out the Season 3 story cinematic trailer for Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 for a peek at what's coming in this new season.
